original_source: U.S. Food and Drug Administration Product-Specific Guidance (PSG) documents, https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/psg/

effective_dates.source: document header dates in corpus text
effective_dates.note: No structured effective_date field; dates are embedded in FDA guidance text.

approved_components: data/corpus.jsonl (7,123 FDA PSG chunks with source URLs)
required_raw_sources: FDA Product-Specific Guidance PDFs referenced by source_url in each corpus chunk
reason: Well-structured pharma retrieval benchmark with exclusive one-to-one query-chunk mappings, an included raw corpus, and a permissive Apache-2.0 licence. Query text and expected answers are LLM-generated/validated abstractive summaries (not verbatim extracts), and corpus chunks share substantial FDA boilerplate, producing high near-duplicate overlap. Approved as an evaluation candidate only; not golden-ground-truth status.
